claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: PHTPP is a selective ERβ antagonist that is unlikely to kill cells broadly at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would be limited to ERβ-dependent cancer lines, with no evidence of a dominant cytotoxic off-target.
